comment_regular: Verified behavior: script-argument wrapper for setting a reference lock level. It obtains/creates ExtraLockData, writes a nonzero supplied level, sets locked bit 0x01, marks the reference modified, and when its optional second argument is positive propagates unlocked=false to the linked door's owner cells. It marks the form active-file modified and logs `Locked %s with lock level %d` in console mode. Candidate command identity is Lock; registration/name-table evidence remains Unknown.
